title: Build a simple user greeting API

subtasks.title: Create greeting API endpoint
subtasks.description: Create a simple Express.js API with a GET /api/greet/:name endpoint that returns a JSON greeting. Include proper error handling for missing name parameter.

subtasks.title: Add greeting UI component
subtasks.description: Create a simple React component that calls the greeting API and displays the result. Use the API endpoint created by the backend developer.

subtasks.title: Add input validation and tests
subtasks.description: Review the code created by previous personas. Add input validation to sanitize the name parameter and write basic tests for the API endpoint.
